description: Enqueue rebasing a merge request's source branch against its target branch. HTTP 202 means queued, not completed. Poll the retrieve merge request endpoint with include_rebase_in_progress=true to check rebase_in_progress and merge_error. Requires permission to push to the source branch, including force push when protected. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#rebase-a-merge-request.

id.description: Project ID or unencoded namespace/project path.
id.title: Id

merge_request_iid.description: Project-local IID of the merge request.
merge_request_iid.title: Merge Request Iid

skip_ci.description: Set to true to skip creating a CI pipeline.
skip_ci.title: Skip Ci

name: rebase_merge_request

rebase_in_progress.description: Whether the asynchronous rebase is in progress; not proof of completion.
rebase_in_progress.title: Rebase In Progress
